scope: Small synthetic real-model comparisons of two specific community-derived weights, not model certification. No user files, browser, desktop, terminal or MCP operations were used. Agent cases ran in temporary workspaces. Tool output previews are synthetic. Tool-case output limit was 128 tokens; Agent limit was 512.

environment.memoryGuard: At least 35% reported system-wide free at the start of each weight run; terminate the owned server below 20%.

weights.note: SHA-256 was computed for the entire downloaded GGUF before inference.

templates.note: Source hashes are raw file bytes; runtime hashes are server-reported representations that can have normalized whitespace.

method.samplingCaveat: Requested values were sent through Harness; server-reported defaults are not proof of effective per-request values. Google specifies temperature, top-p and top-k; min-p=0 was an additional experimental choice.
method.passCriteria: Exact tool name and argument value, strict no-tool response, and correct tool-result follow-up; see gemma_tool_eval.
method.isolation: Each server process was checked against its listening PID, sole model alias and reported template hash. Each condition disabled the prompt cache; no different 26B model was run concurrently.
